title: Get a permit to film on council land
what: Get the council's permit before commercial filming or photography on roads, parks or other council land.

laws.title: Local Government Act 1993 New South Wales

sources.title: Local Government Act 1993 (NSW)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A person intending to carry out a filming project may lodge with the council a filming proposal in which the person makes an application for one or more approvals that are necessary in order to enable the filming project to be carried out and that may be granted by the council (acting in any capacity) under this or any other Act or law.

sources.title: Local Government Act 1993 (NSW)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: The purpose of this Division is to establish a streamlined procedure for obtaining any council approvals that are necessary in order to carry out filming.

sources.title: Approval for filming council of the city of sydney

confidence_note: The Act sets one procedure for the council approvals filming needs (s 115); the approvals themselves come from the council's other powers, such as leases and licences of community land (s 47A(1)(c)).

assessment.summary: Filming on council land needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.
